text:
anya: Quick pass on the Private setup wizard visual hierarchy — the connectivity status row feels too visually heavy and is pulling attention away from the primary stepper. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/example (mock) tom: agree. stepper should be the anchor. the status pills are taking the whole horizontal line. can we reduce weight and use a smaller affordance? :thinking_face: jules: what if we demote the pills to an inline tertiary label and add a single compact indicator on the left of each probe result? keeps info but reduces noise. anya: exactly — reduce pill border and move the detailed counts into a collapse. compact indicator could be a 12px circle with color + subtle tooltip on hover. kevin: accessibility note: color-only indicators will fail contrast for several palettes. we need an extra explicit text label for screen readers and a visible outline state for keyboard focus. also ensure aria-live for probe updates so VO users hear progress. jules: good point. for aria-live I'm thinking: ```html
Connectivity: 3/5 ports reachable
``` but we should ensure it doesn't spam when a lot of small probe updates happen. kevin: use polite + debounce updates (2000ms). and include sr-only text like "Probe complete: 3 of 5 ports reachable" when status changes. anya: copy tweak suggestion for the collapsed details: "View probe details (opens diagnostics)" instead of "More info" — more action-focused. tom: +1 on copy. also UX question: when a probe fails, we currently show a red pill and a modal CTA. can we instead show inline repair suggestions first? modal is high friction for minor fixes. jules: propose pattern: inline hints with a single lightweight "Run fix" button that opens modal only if repair requires elevated steps. keeps flow in context. deploy-bot: [deploy] ui/staging updated: private-wizard/compact-status v1.3 deployed at 2025-06-03 14:18 UTC :rocket: anya: seeing the new build in staging now, quick visual feedback: the smaller pill works, but the contrast for the "warning" amber is borderline on the panel bg. can we test WCAG AA? :a11y: kevin: will run contrast checks this afternoon and attach a small table of hex values + pass/fail. also I'll test VoiceOver with the debounced aria-live to confirm users hear the final state only. tom: action items: (1) jules to wire compact indicator + collapsed details; (2) kevin to run contrast + VO test; (3) anya to update microcopy for CTAs; (4) I'll validate modal fallback flows. plan to review in tomorrow's 10am sync. :calendar: anya: thanks — added to the board (TICKET-4127). I'll paste a short gif of interaction once I refine the hover tooltip. :eyes:
